title: 2008 AMC 8 Problem 21
statement: Jerry cuts a wedge from a \(6\)-cm cylinder of bologna as shown by the dashed curve. Which answer choice is closest to the volume of his wedge in cubic centimeters?

solutions.text:
The cylinder has diameter \(8\) cm, so its radius is \(4\) cm. Its length is \(6\) cm.

The whole cylinder has volume \(\pi r^2h=\pi\cdot4^2\cdot6=96\pi\).

The dashed cut takes half of the cylinder, so the wedge has volume \(48\pi\), which is about \(151\) cubic centimeters.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: The cylinder has radius \(4\) cm and length \(6\) cm.
The dashed cut takes half the cylinder.
